description: Rumble channel uploads — lean streams[{url,type}]; call video-details for rendition meta. Costs ~12 credits (0.6/result). Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 200). Billed per result.

url.description: Rumble channel URL, e.g. https://rumble.com/c/name. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.
